<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "parsed entity text">
  <!ENTITY % pent "parameter entity text">
  %pent;
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction value"?>
  <!-- Main DTD internal subset comment -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Document level comment -->
  <?root-pi processing="true"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like characters: <tag>&ent;</tag>
    ]]>
  </child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; with extension">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- Comment inside DOCTYPE -->
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:x="http://xml.org/ext">
  <!-- Top-level comment -->
  <?xml-pi target="value"?>
  <x:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with ENTITY reference: &derived;
    ]]>
  </x:section>
</document>
```

  <!-- Enterprise DTD comment -->
]>

  <?sec-pi check="pass"?>

    ]]>

</enterprise>
